description: Startup bundle budget in bytes, checked by npm run check:bundle after npm run build. Measured sizes plus about 3%. Phase 2 (2026-11-08) lowered entry JS from 8,051,095 raw / 2,622,933 gzip to 4,185,503 / 1,319,171 and entry CSS from 594,839 / 94,102 to 532,281 / 84,739. staticImportsJs now holds the vendor chunk (Vue, Pinia, vue-i18n: 109,909 / 42,157), moved out of the entry, so entry plus static imports fell by 3.76 MB raw. Lower each limit when a work package shrinks the bundle; never raise one to land a change.
